title: CAM-54 slice 3: real CodexAdapter (codex exec spawn-argv) + per-phase adapter selection
description: CAM-54 slice-3 (per ADR-0046/0047 slice sequence; slice-2 shipped as CAM-349). Add the second BackendAdapter implementation so the OpenAI codex CLI (v0.144.6, `codex exec`) can be a worker backend selectable per-phase alongside claude. Grounded against the real installed codex CLI; the six ADR-0047 mismatches resolve as: F2 completion (codex agent writes worker-report.json + prints CAM_*_STATUS sentinel via injected instructions, identical uniform contract, no read-side branch); F4 agent-prompt (no --agent flag; strip frontmatter from .claude/agents/<name>.md per spawn, write body to a temp file, pass -c model_instructions_file=<tmp>); F5 sandbox/env (--sandbox {read-only|workspace-write|danger-full-access}, --ask-for-approval never, --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox; codex has NO CLAUDECODE-style nesting guard so no recursion env-strip needed; auth via OPENAI_API_KEY/CODEX_API_KEY); F6 session (codex cannot take a caller-minted --session-id, but the uuid was never load-bearing for completion which is file+pane based, so CodexAdapter ignores the input uuid; post-hoc session correlation deferred to slice-4); F3 token-ceiling (usage.ts is claude .jsonl shaped; codex backend logs token-ceiling-unavailable and skips the backstop, a real codex usage parser is a separate future slice); F1 wiring (add selectAdapter(backend) factory and wire the four dispatch call sites in loop.ts/review.ts/plan-runner.ts to pick ClaudeAdapter vs CodexAdapter via readPhaseBackend, which is currently a dead-end event-only value). Deliverable: CodexAdapter.buildSpawnArgv for all four WorkerActors, the selection factory, graceful token-ceiling degradation for the codex backend, and argv-shape plus back-compat tests (claude argv byte-identical, no live run). A real mixed-backend live dispatch is slice-4, out of scope here. Orchestrator-persona, retry-launcher, and auth-preflight codex parity stay deferred (slice-6).

spec.scope: Add CodexAdapter as the second BackendAdapter implementation in src/supervisor/backend-adapter.ts, producing codex-exec spawn-argv for all four WorkerActors (implementer, planner, auditor, reviewer), plus a selectAdapter(backend) factory wired into the four dispatch call sites (loop.ts implementer, review.ts reviewer, plan-runner.ts planner and auditor) so readPhaseBackend(phase) actually chooses ClaudeAdapter vs CodexAdapter instead of the current dead-end event-only value. CodexAdapter.buildSpawnArgv emits the codex-exec form: a codex-specific env prefix (no CLAUDECODE recursion strip, since codex has no nesting guard), then codex exec with --sandbox and --ask-for-approval flags derived from the same permissionMode/isolation inputs claude uses, -m for the model, and -c model_instructions_file pointed at a per-spawn temp file holding the frontmatter-stripped body of .claude/agents/<agentName>.md, and the escaped task prompt. The uuid input is accepted but not threaded into a session-id flag (codex has none at creation); completion detection stays the existing uniform file-plus-pane contract (worker-report.json + CAM_*_STATUS sentinel / <review> tag), unchanged and un-branched on the read side. For the codex backend the claude-shaped token-ceiling backstop (readWorkerTokens over the .jsonl transcript) degrades gracefully: log a token-ceiling-unavailable notice and skip, never silently break. Claude dispatch argv must remain byte-identical. No live codex run and no mixed-backend end-to-end are in scope (slice-4); orchestrator-persona, retry-launcher, and auth-preflight codex parity stay deferred (slice-6).
acceptanceCriteria: A CodexAdapter class implementing BackendAdapter exists in src/supervisor/backend-adapter.ts; buildSpawnArgv returns a codex exec command string for each of the four WorkerActors (implementer, planner, auditor, reviewer).

CodexAdapter argv uses codex exec with a --sandbox mode and --ask-for-approval (or --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox) derived from the permissionMode/isolation inputs, -m <model> from opts.model, and -c model_instructions_file=<tmpfile> where the tmpfile holds the .claude/agents/<agentName>.md body with YAML frontmatter stripped.

CodexAdapter does NOT emit a --session-id flag and does NOT emit any env -u strip for a claude-style nesting guard; the codex env prefix is derived from a codex-specific unset list (may be empty for host isolation).

A selectAdapter(backend) factory (or equivalent) returns ClaudeAdapter for 'claude' and CodexAdapter for 'codex'; the four dispatch call sites (loop.ts, review.ts, plan-runner.ts planner + auditor) construct their adapter through it using the already-resolved readPhaseBackend(phase) value rather than hardcoding new ClaudeAdapter().

When the resolved backend for a phase is 'codex', the token-ceiling backstop path logs a token-ceiling-unavailable notice and skips rather than attempting to parse a claude .jsonl transcript; claude phases keep the existing token-ceiling behavior unchanged.

buildImplementerWorkerArgv / buildPlannerWorkerArgv / buildAuditorWorkerArgv / buildReviewerWorkerArgv still produce byte-identical claude argv when the backend is claude (back-compat), asserted by tests.
New tests cover CodexAdapter argv shape for all four actors and the factory selection (claude vs codex) by phase; typecheck and the full test suite pass green.
gotchas: codex exec is the non-interactive analog to claude; the -o/--output-last-message and --json flags are optional extras and are NOT the completion contract, the agent still writes scripts/cam/worker-report.json and prints the CAM_*_STATUS sentinel itself via its injected instructions.

codex has no --agent flag; the agent body must be injected via -c model_instructions_file pointing at a per-spawn temp file (strip the YAML frontmatter first). Prefer the stateless per-spawn temp-file approach over pre-materializing profiles under the operator's real $CODEX_HOME to avoid clobbering user config.

codex has no CLAUDECODE-style self-nesting guard, so the codex env prefix must NOT reuse claude's WORKER_ENV_UNSET; author a codex-specific (possibly empty) unset list. Do not blindly reuse workerEnvPrefix.

codex cannot be given a deterministic session id at creation (no --session-id); the caller-minted uuid stays claude-only. Do not attempt to correlate a codex session by the minted uuid; completion detection does not depend on it.

The claude argv path must stay byte-identical; the factory must default to claude and the existing thin wrappers (buildImplementerWorkerArgv etc.) must keep constructing the claude path unchanged when backend is claude.
Container isolation wrapping (dockerExecWrap) happens at the call site OUTSIDE buildSpawnArgv; keep the adapter output host/container agnostic as ClaudeAdapter already does.
Write any stdin payloads to /tmp, never under .claude/, to avoid tripping the plan preflight clean-tree guard.
domainTerms: BackendAdapter: the seam interface (single method buildSpawnArgv(actor, opts)) that abstracts worker spawn-argv per LLM backend.
WorkerActor: one of implementer | planner | auditor | reviewer.
readPhaseBackend: src/config/models.ts accessor resolving the backend name for a phase from project.toml [backend], shipped in slice-2 (CAM-349).
codex exec: the codex CLI non-interactive subcommand that runs a prompt to completion and exits.
model_instructions_file: codex config key (settable via -c) pointing at a file whose contents become the agent instructions, codex's closest analog to claude --agent.
